---
title: Quarto extensions
author: Mickaël Canouil
version: 1.0.0
format:
  mcanouil-revealjs:
    slide-number: false
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    footer:
      right: version
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A deck whose author turned the slide number off gives no slide number warning when the right footer slot holds something else.
    mcanouil-revealjs:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['slideNumber: false', '<span class="mc-slot mc-slot-right">1\.0\.0</span>']
        - ['mc-slot-page']
---
